_comment: PLAN-TWO-MAPS item 8 (docs/progress/two-maps-item-8-ai-anchors.md) -- Arena's own AI patrol hub/core-point topology for iceberg, raw-decoded from the excluded TeamFight_AI scene (tools/extract/extract_ai_anchors.py). Loaded at raid start by ArenaMapPort.Client/AiAnchors.cs in place of AICorePointFallback/PatrolWayFallback's NavMesh-derived synthesis; a missing/invalid file (any map without a sidecar) keeps that synthesis unchanged. No connection/edge data: AICorePoint.ConnectionsAtNet is never populated outside the Unity Editor's own Gizmos callbacks (see extract_ai_anchors.py's module docstring), so every authored core point here has empty connections, same as today's single synthetic point. 4 hub(s) with 40 sub point(s) of Arena's PatrolWay lie outside the play area and are not shipped (see the extractor's docstring, 'Iceberg'); with no hub left patrol_ways is empty and PatrolWayFallback builds NavMesh-derived ways from the Bot spawn markers.
